name: Doppler Effect
subject: waves

source.creator: 3D Education Engine
source.attribution: Educational model generated procedurally by 3D Education Engine, based on the standard equations of motion stated in the simulation.

educational.disclaimer: Seen from above. Each ring is one wave crest, spreading from where the source was when it made it. Slowed down a great deal so the crests can be watched.

equations: in front (source coming): f′ = f·v / (v − vs)
behind (source going away): f′ = f·v / (v + vs)
